dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Post-infectious autoimmune ocular flutter–ataxia syndrome (a limited opsoclonus–myoclonus spectrum disorder causing acute cerebellar dysfunction)

Alternative 1: Paraneoplastic opsoclonus–myoclonus syndrome, particularly neuroblastoma-associated

Alternative 2: Autoimmune cerebellitis associated with anti-GAD65 or other neuronal antibodies

Alternative 3: Anti-NMDA-receptor encephalitis with ocular flutter–ataxia syndrome
